selected_structure: H1 Plume fusion: Plume took permanent lower-outer interception and roadblock #4 duty; the roster retained Fang, Friston, Midnight, Hibiscus, Ansel, Lancet-2, and Steward. Steward was scheduled to return for late inner damage after artillery clearance.

causal_sequence.facts: Locked [5,5] hit Plume 721, Friston 765, and Ansel 891 physical. Hibiscus healed Ansel 372.6 at 1961.
Locked [5,6] hit Plume 721 and Ansel 891; Hibiscus healed Ansel 318.4 at 2047. Unlike M56, Ansel survived this shell.
The same lock hit Plume 721 and Ansel 891.

causal_sequence.event: Hibiscus was struck by 890 physical at locked [6,2].

causal_sequence.facts: A second 890 shell at the same lock killed her despite nearby self-heal/Lancet support.
The run recorded eight not-deployed errors after deaths; first was Hibiscus@3603.

causal_sequence.event: Steward died to a third 910 shell at locked [7,5].

causal_sequence.facts: The first objective failure followed at frame 5571.
Steward dealt 11035.13 arts over 38 hits, but it had zero BLOCK and was not killed.
Steward dealt 2x249.10 for 498.20 total, but #34 had zero BLOCK and was not killed.

roadblock_settlement.roadblock_1: Steward destroyed it at 13417 after 8250.192 damage.
roadblock_settlement.roadblock_2: Fang destroyed it at 15117 after 8000 damage, after the objective had already failed.
roadblock_settlement.roadblock_3: Midnight destroyed it at 2404 after 8051.4 damage.
roadblock_settlement.roadblock_4: Plume destroyed it at 2131 after 8137.4 damage.

objective_settlement.hostile_spawn_settlement: All 33 hostiles settled as 21 kills plus 12 leaks with zero remaining enemies.
objective_settlement.protected_targets: #3 was killed by artillery at 5353; #14 reached at 15449.

lesson: The Plume structure did resolve M56's Ansel@2111 death and cleared roadblock #4 earlier, but the artillery-medical line failed one stage later: Hibiscus died to a second 890 shell, Steward to a third 910 shell. This released inner pressure into 12 leaks. High artillery damage without blocking still did not kill it, and #34 had only two Steward hits with zero BLOCK.
revision_requirements: Prevent later artillery lock waves from killing Hibiscus and Steward; a first-shell survival is not duty closure.
Provide live eastern/inner block and kill capacity through #21/#22 and late Uterer pressure after medical losses.
Pair artillery output with actual BLOCK or enough burst to kill before leak/protected-target death.
Intercept #34 with real BLOCK and repeated damage; two hits and zero BLOCK are not closure.
Complete roadblock #2/civilian passage before protected-target loss or objective failure.
